instruction: Look up Half-Life 2 and add all expansion packs and DLC to the cart.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: User searches for Half-Life 2 and adds expansion packs/DLC to cart. Evaluator verifies 'Half-Life 2' is present in cart page. Same task structure and difficulty as original, using different game. No custom functions required - uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks all required items including base game 'Half-Life 2' and all expansion packs (Episode One, Episode Two, Lost Coast)
Getter function get_page_info correctly navigates to Steam cart page and retrieves HTML content containing cart items
Metric function is_added_to_steam_cart properly verifies that all expected items appear in cart page content by checking each item name in HTML
Expected values list includes all Half-Life 2 expansion packs that match the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider more robust string matching if item names could vary (e.g., case sensitivity, HTML entity encoding), though current simple substring matching is likely sufficient for Steam cart pages
Optional: Could add verification that ONLY these items are in cart (no extra items), though instruction doesn't explicitly require this exclusivity
